headline: A quick pass gains big yards
what_happened: P.Mahomes completed a pass to R.Rice for 31 yards, moving the ball deep into the opponent's territory with only seconds left.
who: P.Mahomes threw the ball to R.Rice.
why_it_matters: Even though they gained a lot of ground, this play actually lowered their chances of winning by 11 percentage points because of the remaining time. The game remains tied at 27-27.
